firmwares.name: Abyssmael
firmwares.description: A six-track generative ambient firmware. Each track has its own instrument (DRONE, PAD, BELL, PLUCK, TEXTURE), envelope, filter, two LFOs, a generator and an arpeggio. A global delay, a shimmer reverb and an AGE layer (tape hiss, vinyl crackle, wow and flutter). Four scenes: DEEP, GLASS, TIDE, VOID. Plays from power-on.
controls: The four parameters on the screen
The 6 tracks and the DARK, ACTIVITY, SPACE macros
The track's sound, envelope and filter, LFOs; SEQ has three sequencer modes per track: GEN (generator), EUCL (Euclidean, a note per hit) and STEP (16 steps on the white keys)
Track mix, then delay, then shimmer reverb
Key and tempo, drift and tuning, then AGE: hiss, crackle, wow
Scale mode (on at power-on): white keys play the scale, the black keys are contextual submenus shown at the bottom of the screen
Tracks, track/scene up and down, page choices; the top black key opens MIX (mute and solo). Tap to open or close, hold to peek
firmwares.credits: Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp by Leo Kuroshita.
